verdicts.reason: A is broken. The cream circle came loose from the can and is stranded, cut off, in the bottom-left corner. Without its backing, the can is an orange outline on an orange background and almost disappears. That leaves a large empty area at the top, and the NEW badge competes with the Try It button. B keeps the can inside the cream circle, but the circle is jammed into the top-left corner and cut off. The subhead is indented and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge. The NEW and Try It buttons are right-aligned against left-aligned text, the NEW badge is almost as big as the call to action, and the buttons are oversized.
